title: Russian — English Wikipedia (WP:RUS)
authority: English Wikipedia guideline WP:RUS (Wikipedia:Romanization of Russian)
description: Practical English romanization of the English Wikipedia (a modification of BGN/PCGN without diacritics or apostrophes): Е→YE word-initially and after vowels, Ъ, Ь (but E after Й); Ё→YO; -ИЙ/-ЫЙ→-Y; Ъ/Ь→Y before А И О У Ы Э, otherwise omitted.
notes: Implements the WP:RUS text, including Е → YE after every vowel (Ерофеев → Yerofeyev); iuliia's JSON omits Е after Е, Ё, Ы (Yerofeev). The special provision '-ые endings → -ye' (Набережные → Naberezhnye) overrides it at word end; inside a word ЫЕ gives yye.
-ИЙ → -Y is the rule for personal names and adjectives of Russian origin; WP:RUS uses -IY for nouns and non-Russian words (Рыркайпий → Ryrkaypiy), which cannot be decided by letters alone.
Ё is always YO by this guideline; English Wikipedia article titles nevertheless keep established spellings (Gorbachev, Khrushchev, Tchaikovsky).

rules.note: word start, after vowels, Ъ, Ь; e after consonants and Й
